title: 2011 AMC 10B Problem 18
statement: Rectangle \(ABCD\) has \(AB = 6\) and \(BC = 3.\) Point \(M\) is chosen on side \(AB\) so that \(\angle AMD = \angle CMD.\) What is the degree measure of \(\angle AMD?\)

solutions.text:
The angles \(\angle AMD \) and \(\angle MDC \) are equal since \(AB \parallel DC.\)

As such, \(\angle MDC = \angle DMC ,\) making \(MDC \) isosceles and \(MC = DC = 6.\)

As we can see, \(\sin (\angle CMB) = \frac 12,\) making \(\angle CMB = 30^\circ .\)

Therefore, \(\angle AMC = 150^\circ .\) Since \(\angle AMD \) is half of that, \(\angle AMD = 75^\circ .\)

Thus, the correct answer is E .
hints: Use \(AB\parallel CD\) to transfer one angle to \(\angle CDM\)
